description: Each entry of a `.ic` card names one net's initial voltage. An entry that cannot be read is an error rather than skipped, because a transient started without one of its initial conditions is a different run.
actions: Write the entry as `V(net)=value`, for example `V(out)=2.5`.
A differential `V(a,b)` or a current `I(...)` is not accepted; set those through the element's own `IC=`.
